payload.title: Validate Clay cross-organ work and possibility projection bridge

work_clay.task: Verify local Claude sync publishes safe hash-stable CURRENT_DYNAMIC_WORK.clay and CURRENT_SYSTEM_POSSIBILITY.clay to origin without merging/disturbing the worktree. Verify a remote ChatGPT organ can read both projections and that no secret-like fields leak.

reason_clay.why: Hosted ChatGPT cannot open local SQLite. The repo projections are required for a real shared possibility/work surface.

tests: unchanged projection does not create needless semantic change
remote read reconstructs current work ids and capability states

invalidators: projection transport replaced by a validated lower-cost equivalent
